reason: Conversation 2 opens with the right first step: unplug the dryer and turn the drum by hand. That gives the key finding of no resistance, and it also gives safe panel-removal guidance and an honest note that the incomplete model number prevents confirming the exact belt. Conversation 1 wastes turns on an irrelevant spin-only programme for a washer and asks about overloading. It also wrongly refuses panel instructions and tells the customer to run the machine again after the belt strip was already seen. Its final answer is vaguer and contradicts itself, saying the customer cannot safely access internals and then giving only generic panel guidance. Conversation 2 does end by leaning towards an engineer, which is more cautious than needed for a reasonable DIY repair, but it avoids unsupported part claims and is far more coherent and useful.
